rationale: The append is committed before receipt polling, yet missing observation returns an error; a caller retry can therefore append the same value again.
The Channel contract does not define whether false means definitely unsent or merely unconfirmed, nor whether the token makes retries idempotent, so repeated effects cannot be established.
execute unconditionally enters Running and invokes the worker from every phase, so a completed, failed, or already-running task can be executed again instead of enforcing the declared lifecycle.
The new key discards workspace, causing equal job names in distinct workspaces to collide and making the second admission incorrectly fail.
The refactored key retains both workspace and job and adds fixed namespace labels; no scope component is lost or made unstable.
